F01.unproved: Whether the real semantic normalizer retains source links and leaves ambiguous job associations reviewable on held-out resumes; fixture and literal assertions do not establish model behavior.
F01.owner: T17 model evaluation after D004 gate
F01.check: Run the separately reviewed held-out source manifest through the permitted CLI, inspect every source link, duplicate and ambiguous association, and retain human review of semantic matches.

G01.unproved: The real path has two application-level logical content operations and one scoped rewrite; actual CLI internal request counts and unrelated payload disclosure remain unmeasured. Injected counters prove application dispatch only.
G01.owner: T17 live CLI evaluation after D004 gate
G01.check: Measure application-level normalize, draft and rewrite operations on the approved profile. Report CLI internal requests from supported metadata when available, otherwise mark them unknown; inspect only synthetic scoped payloads and confirm deterministic routes use zero inference.

G02.unproved: The selected real CLI version follows the decoded event/error and retry contract, including reported internal requests, auth, quota and model failures; scripted fake events do not prove version behavior.
G02.owner: T17 CLI protocol evaluation after D004 gate
G02.check: Run bounded real-profile event/error probes and record raw event shapes, error classification, reported tokens and internal retries without candidate data.

G03.unproved: Native CLI metadata and synthetic operation-owned artifacts have not shown whether login, status, generation, cancellation and detach retain candidate content or affect existing sessions; fake executable checks cannot prove native behavior.
G03.owner: T17 CLI isolation evaluation after D004 gate
G03.check: Use native CLI metadata and only approved isolated synthetic operation-owned paths before and after explicit actions, idle status, cancellation and detach; verify no global logout from metadata. Never read or copy auth credentials, or inspect or delete unrelated existing histories; report retention unresolved if metadata is insufficient.

D01.unproved: Ordinary editing and pagination of the generated DOCX in Microsoft Word on a claimed reader/OS; automated DOCX XML and LibreOffice reconversion do not prove Word behavior.
D01.check: Open the fixed synthetic outputs in Word and LibreOffice on each claimed reader/OS, edit an ordinary paragraph, save and reopen, and inspect pagination, logos and text.

D02.unproved: Final approved visual review of every release layout and claimed converter/OS, including long content, without clipping or blank pages; fixed-environment baselines cover the current synthetic set.
D02.check: Render the declared release fixtures on each claimed converter/OS, compare approved page images and text/geometry, and inspect any new or long layout before acceptance.

R01.unproved: Real CLI candidate retention in synthetic operation-owned paths and OS-level crash residue after a live operation remain unproved; local fake child and app-owned restart cleanup do not observe native CLI retention or OS persistence.
R01.owner: T17 privacy release QA after D004 gate
R01.check: Use native CLI metadata and approved isolated synthetic operation-owned paths to check retention after success, cancel and crash/restart; compare only app-owned temp roots. Never read or copy auth credentials, or inspect or delete unrelated existing histories. Mark native retention unknown where metadata cannot prove it; document OS swap/download limits.

B01.unproved: The full import-to-reopen workflow with real semantic generation and rewrite; separate fixture browser workflows do not prove the D004-blocked live chain.
B01.owner: T17 end-to-end release QA after D004 gate
B01.check: Run one bounded held-out browser path from import through facts, edit, scoped rewrite, review, PDF/DOCX/project downloads and reopen, with recorded keyboard/focus and error states.

N01.unproved: The fixed synthetic parser, render and browser edit samples do not measure extracted-text-visible latency through upload/worker/UI, true fresh-machine cold conversion, hard peak memory, or real CLI requests/tokens under D004.
N01.owner: Release performance QA after D004 and clean-host availability
N01.check: Measure the complete import UI and true cold install on the declared host, establish peak memory bounds separately, and record native CLI counts/tokens only after D004 opens; retain fixture sample counts and conditions.

L01.unproved: The tested local host has setup/preflight and launcher smoke evidence, but a fresh install from a clean checkout, full path-with-spaces launch and all error/stop cases have not been verified on a clean macOS 26.6.2 arm64 host.
L01.check: On a clean claimed host, install documented pinned dependencies, test a checkout path with spaces, start/stop the launcher and exercise missing dependency, font, asset and owned-process cleanup cases.
